steps: Log in to the Academic Information System (학사정보시스템).
Open Student Services > Classes/Grades > Grades > 교과목중복인정신청.

summary: Apply online anytime for 교과목 중복인정 (double-counting of shared courses across majors); see the attached manual for details.
title: Apply online for course double-counting

학생 서류 제출 &

english: Under Article 5 (교과목 중복인정, Double Recognition of Courses), Paragraph 1 of the Seoul National University Regulations on Major Requirements for Undergraduate Programs (서울대학교 학사과정 전공 이수 규정), major courses that are recognized in common by a primary major, a double major and an interdisciplinary major (연합전공) may be counted for credit in more than one of these majors. This also includes common courses within a college. Based on this regulation, the application procedure for double recognition of courses has been improved. The new procedure is explained in the attached manual, and students to whom this applies should submit an application.
1) Improvements to the double recognition of courses process
Apply during the graduation review period (졸업사정, check of graduation requirements) in the semester of graduation

Student submits documents &
Department and college staff enter the result into the system by hand

Student applies directly in 학사정보시스템 (Academic Information System) &
Once department and college staff approve, the result is automatically applied to the graduation review and the 졸업시뮬레이션 (Graduation Simulation)

(Student application and cancellation) 학사정보시스템 (Academic Information System) > 학생서비스 (Student Services) > 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) > 성적 (Grades) > 교과목중복인정신청 (Application for Double Recognition of Courses)
